traits.name: Gnome Cunning
traits.description: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

traits.name: Speak with Small Beasts
traits.description: You can communicate simple ideas with Small or smaller beasts.

traits.name: Minor Illusion
traits.description: You know the minor illusion cantrip.

originFeat.name: Magic Initiate (Druid)
originFeat.description: Learn two druid cantrips and one 1st-level druid spell (cast once without a slot). Wisdom is your spellcasting ability.

skills.name: Stealth
skills.description: You move quietly through wilderness areas, avoiding detection by both prey and predators.

skills.name: Survival
skills.description: Tracking, foraging, predicting weather, and navigating wilderness are second nature.

tools.name: Cartographer's Tools
tools.description: Used to create accurate maps, mark trails, and record important landmarks.

userChoices.description: You seek balance or remain unaligned, like a druid preserving nature’s equilibrium or a scholar studying all sides without bias.
